name: Full Body Strength Pioneer
description: Heavy compound movements engineered to build maximum foundational power and muscular density.

exercises.name: Barbell Squats
exercises.instructions: Brace hard, sit down and drive up with the bar packed on traps.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Pin shoulder blades, touch chest, press with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Rows
exercises.instructions: Hinged torso, row to navel, elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Press from collarbone, glutes braced, bar path straight up.

name: Dumbbell Power & Core
description: Dynamic dumbbell strength circuit focusing on multi-joint power and core stability.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thrusters
exercises.instructions: Front-rack dumbbells, squat deep, press overhead in one drive.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rows
exercises.instructions: Hinge flat-backed, row dumbbell to hip.

exercises.name: Goblet Squats
exercises.instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest, squat to parallel.

exercises.name: Renegade Rows
exercises.instructions: Plank position, row one arm at a time keeping hips square.

name: Cardio Endurance Engine
description: Sustained aerobic conditioning workout designed to boost lung capacity and caloric burn.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.instructions: Drive knees to hip height at a fast, controlled tempo.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.instructions: Keep knees soft, land lightly on balls of feet.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.instructions: Keep hips low, alternate knees to chest rapidly.

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing
exercises.instructions: Light on feet, snap punches, maintain rhythmic breathing.

name: Vinyasa Flow & Release
description: Mindful movement flow to decompress joints, improve posture, and lengthen tight muscles.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Flow
exercises.instructions: Alternate rounding and arching spine slowly with breath.

exercises.name: Downward Dog Walks
exercises.instructions: In downward dog, pedal heels slowly to lengthen calves and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Child’s Pose Hold
exercises.instructions: Kneel wide, reach arms long, sink hips back to heels.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose
exercises.instructions: Front shin transverse, square hips, fold forward gently.

name: 20-Min High Intensity Shred
description: Fast-paced interval blast maximizing EPOC (afterburn) through explosive bodyweight movements.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop, kick back to plank, push up, jump up in one fluid motion.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.instructions: Explode upward, absorb landing softly into next squat.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.instructions: Sprint knees to chest while holding solid plank position.

exercises.name: Plank Jacks
exercises.instructions: In plank, jump feet wide and together with steady hips.

name: Upper Body Hypertrophy
description: Precision muscle-building session focused on chest, back, shoulders, and arms.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Retract scapula, lower bar to sternum, drive up with control.

exercises.name: Barbell Rows
exercises.instructions: Pull bar to lower ribs, squeeze lats at peak contraction.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Press dumbbells overhead in tight arc, control descent.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.instructions: Lean slightly forward, lower until upper arms are parallel to floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curls
exercises.instructions: Keep elbows fixed at sides, flex bicep hard at top.

name: Bodyweight Mastery Routine
description: Pure bodyweight strength training to master push, pull, and core leverage.

exercises.name: Pull Ups
exercises.instructions: Overhand grip, drive elbows down, pull chest to bar.

exercises.name: Push Ups
exercises.instructions: Body straight as a plank, lower chest to floor.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.instructions: Full depth dips, keep shoulders packed.

exercises.name: Pike Push Ups
exercises.instructions: Elevate hips high in pike position, lower crown of head to floor.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank Hold
exercises.instructions: Brace core and glutes hard, maintain flat spinal alignment.

name: Foundational Fitness Start
description: Safe, effective introductory workout building basic movement mechanics and confidence.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.instructions: Sit back into heels, chest proud, knees tracking over toes.

exercises.name: Incline Push Ups
exercises.instructions: Hands elevated on bench/step to build pressing strength.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.instructions: Light cadence, soft landing, smooth arm arc.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Hold tight line from head to heels without sagging.

name: Full Body Joint & Spine Relief
description: Essential joint mobilization and hip/thoracic opening to improve daily movement and speed recovery.

exercises.name: World’s Greatest Stretch
exercises.instructions: Deep lunge, rotate ribcage to ceiling, open hips and thoracic spine.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
exercises.instructions: Seated 90/90 position, fold tall over front shin.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.instructions: Half-kneeling, tuck pelvis under, squeeze posterior glute.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotations
exercises.instructions: On all fours, rotate upper spine to ceiling without twisting hips.
